subject: SCCs pathway recommendation & evidence timeline — MedAlign review
messages:
From: Sam Cooper <sam.cooper@medalign.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: dpo@medalign.com
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCCs module preference + evidence request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal is reviewing the transfer mechanism sections and asked whether Redwood is able to commit to a specific SCCs module for our EU->US flows. They want to lock the module in before the DPA signature to avoid later rework.

Two asks from my side:
1) Which SCCs module is Redwood prepared to execute for controller->processor flows with MedAlign (we're a controller)?
2) A short list of the tangible artifacts/evidence your team can provide up front (DPIA notes, encryption key custody details, audit logs samples, SOC 2 scope confirmation, anything else).

Can you share a recommended path and an estimated delivery timeline? If this is something your legal/privacy team needs to own directly, please loop them in.

Appreciate it — we need to present this to our DPO by next Wednesday.

Best,
Sam
Sam Cooper
Head of Legal Operations | MedAlign
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Cooper <sam.cooper@medalign.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCCs module preference + evidence request

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear asks and for flagging the DPO deadline. Looping in Ben (Legal) and Laura (Privacy) as they will own the formal SCCs language and evidence pack.

Short answer up front: our recommended execution path for MedAlign is the SCCs pathway appropriate to controller->processor relationships. Practically that means we will execute the SCCs Module 2-equivalent (controller to processor) for EU transfers, plus the UK addendum where requested. We find this minimizes negotiation surface for customers who are controllers and keeps the DPA alignment straightforward.

What we can provide immediately (high level):
- A completed SCCs module selection matrix (attached spreadsheet) identifying the clauses we sign and the UK addendum mapping.
- DPIA summary (high-level) describing data flows for tokenized/prompt data and retention windows.
- SOC 2 scope confirmation statement and the date of our most recent report (available on request under NDA).
- Example audit-log schema and a one-page description of retention and access controls.
- Incident response runbook summary and nominal SLAs for notification.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (EOD): send module selection matrix + evidence roadmap (we've attached v1).
- +2 business days: Ben to provide redlined SCCs language or confirm standard text for execution.
- +4 business days: Laura to provide DPIA summary and any additional privacy controls MedAlign will want referenced in the DPA.

If that works, we'll follow with a single zip of evidence artifacts and a short cover letter your DPO can use. If you need the SOC 2 report itself, we typically share that under a short NDA — let me know and we'll kick that off.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCCs module preference + evidence request

Grace / Laura — quick internal note on approach and risk items before we send to MedAlign:

1) Module selection: I agree with recommending the controller->processor module (Module 2-equivalent). That is the cleanest fit given MedAlign's role. We'll include a short rationale paragraph in the cover letter so their counsel sees the mapping explicitly.

2) Evidence pack contents (we should include all of the following):
   - Signed SOC 2 Atlas report or a redacted copy (NDA required).
   - Diagram: logical data flows for prompts/outputs and any logs retained beyond session (single-page).
   - Key management note: we use cloud KMS; for customers on dedicated/private we can discuss BYOK options.
   - Encryption-at-rest and in-transit statements, with cipher suites and TLS version.
   - Incident response timeline + template notification (72-hour escalation for confirmed exfil).
   - Audit log sample and schema (redacted).
   - DPIA summary (Laura to confirm content).

3) Timeline risk: if the customer insists on seeing the signed SOC 2 report before DPA signature, expect +5 business days to process the NDA and provide a redacted report. Otherwise, we can proceed with a SOC 2 confirmation letter that references the audit and provides dates.

I'll draft the SCCs language suggestions this afternoon and attach them to Grace's cover letter. Laura — if you can confirm the DPIA summary items and the minimum set of fields we must include for MedAlign's DPO, I'll slot it into the roadmap.

—Ben
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Cooper <sam.cooper@medalign.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCCs module preference + evidence request

Sam — attaching the SCCs module evaluation matrix and our initial evidence roadmap (v1). Key points below for your DPO:

- Recommended pathway: controller->processor SCCs module (Module 2-equivalent) + UK addendum mapping. Rationale: matches MedAlign's controller role and avoids conversion ambiguity.
- Evidence we'll include in the package: DPIA summary (high-level), SOC 2 scope confirmation + redacted report under NDA, KMS/encryption notes, audit log schema, incident response template.
- If you want the SOC 2 report up front, we'll need a signed NDA (we can provide a standard one today); otherwise we'll include the confirmation letter and deliver the report on NDA execution.
- Requested next steps from MedAlign: please confirm (1) DPO contact for final review, (2) whether you need the full SOC 2 before DPA signature, and (3) any bespoke controls we should add to the matrix (e.g., strict data residency notes).

We're prepared to hand this to your DPO as a single package by Tuesday EOD if we get confirmation today on the items above (and a short NDA if SOC 2 is required).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this piece so legal can finalize the DPA.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: sccs-module-eval-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet); evidence-roadmap-v1.pdf (summary); dpia-summary.pdf (one-page)
